subject: Post-call procurement readiness — onboarding path options & required paperwork
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Olivia Moreno <olivia@aurumhealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + paperwork & onboarding path options

Hi Olivia — great to meet today. Quick recap from our call and the options we discussed for procurement/onboarding so your procurement team can pick the path that fits best: 

Summary of options we reviewed:
- PO / AP (preferred by many enterprise customers): Redwood provides a vendor setup packet and tax forms (W-9 or W-8) and onboarding materials; invoice terms typically net30 unless otherwise negotiated.
- Marketplace purchase (AWS/GCP/Azure): fast procurement for buyers already preferring marketplace billing; some customers still require an internal PO for budget tracking.
- Corporate card (one-time purchase): possible for initial pilots or pilots under credit limit.

Requested next steps from Aurum procurement:
1) Confirm preferred onboarding path (PO vs Marketplace vs Card).
2) Confirm entity tax form required (W-9 if US entity; W-8 if non-US).
3) Provide banking contact or a bank verification letter and preferred remittance details if PO/AP.
4) If PO path: any required vendor portal (Coupa/Ariba/Workday) or special fields we need to include on the vendor packet.

I've attached a fillable vendor packet to speed things up — includes sections for tax id, bank info, and procurement portal details. If you prefer we can push a vendor enrollment invitation into your portal once you confirm the path.

Happy to coordinate a short follow-up with our finance ops if helpful.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com
(415) 555-0147
Attachment: Aurum_Vendor_Packet_Fillable.pdf (PDF, 1 page fillable packet)

From: Olivia Moreno <olivia@aurumhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@aurumhealth.com, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 18:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + paperwork & onboarding path options

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from Aurum procurement: 

- Preferred path: PO via our Coupa instance. We can also use a marketplace for a pilot, but corporate policy prefers PO routing for anything > $5k/month.
- Tax forms: Aurum is US-based — we'll need Redwood's completed W-9 to process vendor setup.
- Banking: we require a bank verification letter for new vendors (signed by bank on bank letterhead) or ACH authorization form.
- Portal fields: Coupa requires our vendor taxonomy code, NAICS, and the bank ACH details in a specific layout — I can send a sample vendor enrollment export once we start the packet.

Action items for Redwood: 
- Please send completed W-9 and a sample invoice template so AP can confirm required PO fields.
- Can you confirm standard invoice terms (net30) and whether Redwood accepts 1099 reporting?
- Please provide expected monthly spend estimate for the first 90 days so we can route the budget approval.

Attaching our procurement requirements checklist and a sample bank letter template.

Olivia Moreno
Senior Procurement Manager, Aurum Health
olivia@aurumhealth.com
Attachment: W-9_Aurum_Moreno.pdf (attached: placeholder - we'll attach completed forms when ready)
Attachment: Bank_Verification_Letter.pdf (template)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap + paperwork & onboarding path options

Hannah / Marissa — forwarding Aurum's procurement reply. Key asks from procurement: W-9, bank verification letter (or ACH auth), invoice template, and confirmation of net30 and 1099 handling. They prefer PO via Coupa for anything > $5k/mo and asked for an expected monthly spend for budget routing.

Can finance confirm: 
- Is net30 standard for Redwood mid-market deals?
- Do we provide a pre-filled vendor packet for Coupa (they will need NAICS and vendor taxonomy fields)?
- Who should Aurum expect as the vendor code / contact once the packet is submitted?

I included the fillable packet I sent them. I can schedule a 15-minute alignment call with finance ops if helpful.

Thanks,
Ben
Attachment (forwarded): Aurum_Vendor_Packet_Fillable.pdf

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap + paperwork & onboarding path options

Thanks Ben — looping in next steps and an internal checklist so we move quickly.

Quick answers / guidance for Aurum: 
1) Invoice terms: Net30 is standard for Redwood mid-market by default. We can discuss alternative terms under procurement contracts, but start with net30.
2) 1099 reporting: yes, Redwood will issue 1099s to qualifying US vendors; AP handles that during year-end.
3) Vendor portal enrollment: we support direct Coupa/Ariba enrollments. For Coupa we provide a vendor packet with the NAICS and vendor taxonomy pre-filled if you share the Coupa template/export. Our Ops team usually completes that and returns the signed packet within 5-10 business days after we receive completed tax & bank documents.
4) Vendor code: once AP creates the vendor record we return a vendor number (e.g., RDW-XXXXX) and confirm the remit-to information.

Please send them the attached fillable packet (completed by the customer) + standard invoice template. Ben, suggest we include a quick note on expected first-90-days spend — recommended ask: a best estimate of monthly usage + any pilot discounts to help them route budgets.

I attached our fillable vendor packet for them to complete and return.

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Commercial Finance Ops — Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com
Attachment: Aurum_Vendor_Packet_Fillable.pdf
